whatThisIs: Read X12 277 claim-status responses and 277CA claim acknowledgments without uploading them. The reader keeps every raw category, status, entity and action code visible and puts rejected claims first.
whenToUse: Use this after a clearinghouse or payer returns a claim-status file. It helps you separate rejected claims from accepted or pending work while retaining the source values needed to verify each result.
inputs: One or more X12 277 005010X212 or 277CA 005010X214 text files, up to 50 MB each. Files remain in the browser tab.
output: Rejected, pending and accepted counts; a rejected-first claim table with effective dates and raw codes; an X12 code-lookup link on every row; and full or redacted CSV downloads.

rows: Accepted; A2 / 20 / entity PR / action WQ
